provider: GMX (free) — 65 GB mailbox, IMAP after opt-in, 135 MiB SMTP SIZE

free_tier.stated: GMX's own storage page: "With GMX, you can store up to 65 GB worth of emails. To put that into perspective, that's around 500,000 emails!"
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: 65 GB total is the byte ceiling. Folders can be set to auto-delete on a timer, so retention is user-visible and must be left at 'unlimited'.

tooling: IMAP probe-verified: `imap.gmx.net:993` -> `* OK [CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 CHILDREN ENABLE ID IDLE LIST-EXTENDED LIST-STATUS LITERAL- MOVE NAMESPACE SASL-IR SORT SPECIAL-USE THREAD=ORDEREDSUBJECT UIDPLUS UNSELECT WITHIN AUTH=LOGIN AUTH=PLAIN]`. IMAP is OFF by default and must be toggled on in settings (documented, not a paywall). Same server identity as mail.com. The IMAP banner `H migmxus005` is byte-identical in shape to imap.mail.com's.
chaining: 65 GB × N free accounts. GMX and mail.com are both United Internet properties, but only GMX leaves IMAP open on the free tier. So GMX is the reachable half of that 130 GB pair.
limits_note: per-object-cap from SMTP: `smtp.gmx.com:587` -> `250 SIZE 141557760` = 135 MiB per message (identical value on mail.com, same platform). 65 GB total is the byte ceiling. Folders can be set to auto-delete on a timer, so retention is user-visible and must be left at 'unlimited'.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose: storage page: "With GMX, you can store up to 65 GB worth of emails. To put that into perspective, that's around 500,000 emails!" Free accounts are deleted for inactivity; IMAP access

reliability_note: Free accounts are deleted for inactivity; IMAP access is auto-revoked "for security reasons" after a long period of non-use, so a dormant archive mailbox can lose its programmatic path.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
